originals.name: New Horizon
originals.description: An original bright pop arrangement building from intimate entrances to a shared final refrain.

parts.name: Opening statement
parts.staging: Enter from the left wing and meet the first camera.

arrangements.VOCAL: A sustained melodic opening over instrumental backing.
arrangements.RAP: A measured rhythmic opening over a sung backing refrain.
arrangements.DANCE: An expressive opening movement over the recorded melodic backing.

parts.name: Answering phrase
parts.staging: Cross to the right diagonal and answer the opening.

arrangements.VOCAL: An answering melody with clean changes of register.
arrangements.RAP: An answering flow with distinct rhythmic accents.
arrangements.DANCE: An answering movement phrase with precise directional changes.

parts.name: Bridge
parts.staging: Move through the central diagonal while the others frame the bridge.

arrangements.VOCAL: A restrained bridge rising into the final refrain.
arrangements.RAP: A restrained bridge flow building toward the shared refrain.
arrangements.DANCE: A controlled bridge phrase expanding into the shared formation.

parts.name: Closing lift
parts.staging: Lead the last transition before returning to the equal four-person line.

arrangements.VOCAL: A clear closing melodic lift with instrumental support.
arrangements.RAP: A closing rhythmic lift against the backing hook.
arrangements.DANCE: A closing movement lift against the recorded hook.

originals.name: After the Rain
originals.description: An original mid-tempo performance with interlocking responses and a warm ensemble finish.

parts.name: First light
parts.staging: Begin on the downstage diagonal before opening toward the ensemble.

arrangements.VOCAL: A quiet melodic entrance with a controlled rise.
arrangements.RAP: A quiet rhythmic entrance with a controlled rise.
arrangements.DANCE: A quiet movement entrance with a controlled expansion.

parts.name: Reflection
parts.staging: Mirror the opening from the opposite diagonal.

arrangements.VOCAL: A responsive melodic phrase over the instrumental pulse.
arrangements.RAP: A responsive flow over the instrumental pulse.
arrangements.DANCE: A responsive movement phrase over the backing melody.

parts.name: Turning point
parts.staging: Take the middle crossing while teammates hold the outer marks.

arrangements.VOCAL: A contrasting bridge requiring breath control.
arrangements.RAP: A contrasting bridge requiring clear breath placement.
arrangements.DANCE: A contrasting bridge requiring sustained movement control.

parts.name: Together
parts.staging: Close the crossing and rejoin the shared four-person finish.

arrangements.VOCAL: A final melodic response before the ensemble ending.
arrangements.RAP: A final rhythmic response before the ensemble ending.
arrangements.DANCE: A final movement response before the ensemble ending.

theme.title: Squirrel Life
theme.staging: All eight perform live in two interlocking lines, rotating the camera focus through every member and sharing the final formation. Instrumental and backing arrangements support each primary track.
